infoPlist.NSLocalNetworkUsageDescription: Goose On The Go looks for your Goose In A Pond server on this network so you do not have to type its address.

plugins.cameraPermission: Goose On The Go uses your camera to scan QR codes, such as your Pond's pairing code and the setup code on a device you are adding, and to take photos you choose to send to Goose.

plugins.locationWhenInUsePermission: Goose On The Go uses your location when you ask for a ride fare, so the driver is sent to where you are; when you save a place for a reminder, such as home; at home, to tell your Pond where home is so its weather and local answers are for your area; and, if you turn on Tell Goose where this phone is, to name the place you are in with your messages. A ride's location goes to your Pond and the ride company for that ride; anything else goes to your Pond and nowhere else.
plugins.locationAlwaysAndWhenInUsePermission: Goose On The Go watches only the places you save for reminders, like home or the office, so it can remind you when you arrive or leave. Your Pond hears which place and whether you came or went. Where you are never leaves your phone.
plugins.locationAlwaysPermission: Goose On The Go watches only the places you save for reminders, like home or the office, so it can remind you when you arrive or leave. Your Pond hears which place and whether you came or went. Where you are never leaves your phone.

plugins.microphonePermission: Goose On The Go uses your microphone so you can talk to Goose.

plugins.faceIDPermission: Goose On The Go uses Face ID, when you choose, to open My Pond without typing its admin card.

plugins.photosPermission: Goose On The Go opens your photos so you can choose pictures to send to Goose.
plugins.cameraPermission: Goose On The Go uses your camera to scan QR codes, such as your Pond's pairing code and the setup code on a device you are adding, and to take photos you choose to send to Goose.
plugins.microphonePermission: Goose On The Go uses the microphone when you talk to Goose. What you say goes to your own Pond, nowhere else.
